people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.
translations.bsb: I will restore Judah and Israel from captivity and will rebuild them as in former times.
